title: Structural value meaning
requirement: WHEN an implementation shares an immutable subvalue physically, the interpreter SHALL preserve its structural observations and declared traversal accounting.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Repeated subtree
scenarios.when: A tree has two occurrences of Leaf(4), represented either separately or by one shared node.
scenarios.then: Its fold returns 8 and charges both semantic visits under the same traversal schedule.

expected.traversal accounting: both semantic visits charged under the same schedule

unasserted: equal traversal charge for separate vs shared representation (the host report does not expose the fold phase charge separately)

checks.label: separate occurrences
shared binding

scenarios.name: October 19 refinement: nominal structural equality typing (UIREQ-009 / UIREQ-006)
scenarios.then: body typing SHALL produce Bool whether or not their canonical types agree; an illtyped operand SHALL retain its error.
